evidence.quote: plus $6.5 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval
Fees were discussed before the class relief was agreed.
a modest counteroffer may improve the class recovery and fee without changing those protections.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised attorneys’ fees in their opening settlement proposals, and fees were discussed before final agreement on class relief. One class counsel privately considered improving both the class recovery and its fee, supporting self-interest reasoning. The transcript does not clearly show a fee-for-relief tradeoff, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, prioritization of firm fees over the class, or a misleading declaration.
